provenance: Synthetic edge cases; browser.json/database.json are the actual isolated legacy captures. These are importer requirements, not claims of an implemented importer.

timestamps.policy: Read as BigInt/string and retain exact compatibility value; disabled timer is not a new feature.

attachments.policy: Decode locally; retain ordinal and original reference.
Resolve only through the isolated source file map, never by fetching arbitrary URLs.
No automatic download; preserve raw reference and block migration acceptance until readable or explicitly resolved.
Server cannot recover bytes. Browser upgrade must capture still-live bytes; do not report expired bytes restored.

normalizedGraphCases.policy: Use embedded history; preserve both source representations.
Match pinned legacy fallback/enrichment and reconcile missing nodes from history.
Retain both payloads, compare per field and report conflicts; never flatten or silently drop sibling branches.

browser.crossOrigin: Old sessionStorage/localStorage cannot be read from a new origin.
